svg.title: Technical stack as a dependency matrix
svg.desc: Languages: TypeScript (yukti, skillverse, orion, dilli transit, simdu, mixtape), Python (yukti, simdu, jarvis), SQL (yukti, orion, dilli transit, simdu). Interface: React (yukti, skillverse, orion, dilli transit, simdu, mixtape), Next.js (yukti, dilli transit, simdu), Vite (skillverse, orion, mixtape), Tailwind CSS (skillverse, orion, dilli transit, simdu), three.js · R3F (yukti, skillverse, orion, simdu), GSAP · Framer Motion (simdu, mixtape), React Native · Expo (simdu), PySide6 · QML (jarvis). Server & Data: PostgreSQL · Supabase (yukti, skillverse, orion, dilli transit, simdu), NestJS (dilli transit), Drizzle · Prisma (yukti, dilli transit), Redis · SQLite (dilli transit, jarvis), Better Auth (yukti, dilli transit). Ai & Runtime: LLM features (yukti, skillverse, jarvis), Ollama · Whisper · Piper (jarvis), Pyodide · WebAssembly (yukti). Ship & Test: Vitest · Jest · Playwright (yukti, orion, dilli transit, simdu, mixtape), Vercel · Fly.io · Docker (yukti, orion, dilli transit, simdu, mixtape), Turborepo · pnpm (dilli transit, simdu)
